oauth.description:
Enter your OAuth application credentials.

**Gmail:** Create credentials at [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials). Enable the Gmail API and create an OAuth 2.0 client ID.

**Outlook:** Register your application at [Azure Portal](https://portal.azure.com/#view/Microsoft_AAD_RegisteredApps). Add IMAP.AccessAsUser.All permission.
oauth.title: Mail and Packages — OAuth Credentials

authorize.description:
1. Open the following URL in your browser to authorize access:

`{auth_url}`

2. After authorizing, your browser will redirect to a callback page. Copy the full URL from the browser address bar and paste it below.
